explain.undefinedControlSequence: The command was not recognized. Check for a typo or a missing \usepackage.
explain.missingDollar: Math symbols (like _ or ^) were used outside math mode. Wrap the formula in $…$.
explain.missingBrace: A {'{'} or {'}'} is missing. Check that every brace is paired.
explain.extraBrace: There is an extra {'}'} or a math formula was left open.
explain.tooManyBraces: There is one {'}'} more than needed.
explain.runaway: A command argument was never closed. Look for a missing {'}'} above.
explain.paragraphEnded: A blank line appeared inside a command argument. Remove the empty line.
explain.misplacedAlignment: The & character is only valid in tables. Use \& to print an ampersand.
explain.missingNumber: A number was expected here. Check the command's arguments.
explain.illegalParameter: In definitions, use #1, #2… for parameters (and ## inside nested definitions).
explain.emergencyStop: LaTeX stopped because of the error above. Fix it and compile again.
explain.fatalError: The compilation was aborted and no PDF was produced. Fix the first error listed.
explain.undefinedEnvironment: This environment does not exist. Check the name or load the package that defines it.
explain.environmentMismatch: \begin and \end do not match. Check the nesting of environments.
explain.unicodeCharacter: This character is not supported with the current encoding. Use XeLaTeX/LuaLaTeX or \usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}.
explain.fileNotFound: A file or package was not found. Check the name and path; the package may be installable.
explain.preambleOnly: This command is only allowed in the preamble (before \begin{document}).
explain.commandAlreadyDefined: A command with this name already exists. Use \renewcommand or choose another name.
explain.floatsLost: Some figures or tables could not be placed. Try [htbp] or \clearpage.
explain.overfullBox: A line is too wide for the margin. Rephrase it or add hyphenation hints.
explain.underfullBox: A line was stretched too much (loose spacing). Usually harmless.
explain.undefinedReferences: Some \ref or \cite targets are missing. Compile again; if it persists, check labels and the bibliography.
explain.undefinedReference: The label does not exist yet. Compile twice, or check the \label name.
explain.undefinedCitation: The bibliography entry was not found. Check the key in your .bib file and compile again.
explain.rerunNeeded: Labels changed. Another compilation fixes the cross-references.
explain.multiplyDefined: The same label is defined more than once. Rename one of them.
explain.fontShape: The requested font size or shape is not available; LaTeX used a substitute.
explain.bibMissingEntry: The cited key does not exist in the .bib file.
explain.bibMissingDatabase: The .bib file could not be found. Check the name in \bibliography or \addbibresource.
explain.bibNoCitations: No citations were found. Use \cite in the text and \bibliography at the end.
explain.bibSyntax: There is a syntax error in the .bib entry (missing comma, brace or quote).
explain.latexmkFailed: latexmk failed before running TeX. Check the output in the Log tab.
